speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe the exact location of your chest pain and what you were doing when it started. Are you currently short of breath or sweating profusely?

speaker: Patient
text: The pain is right in the center of my chest, feeling like a tight band squeezing it. It started suddenly about an hour ago while I was sitting at my desk working, and yes, I am definitely short of breath now. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Coronary Syndrome (Unstable Angina or NSTEMI).
